Pragmatic Marketing Certified - 2012 April 11th.

positions.title: Senior developer
positions.description:
Development of Rapidform series -
Especially I was involved deeply at the development of the application framework of XOR and XOV including UI, implementation rule of feature history modeling behavior, command architecture, unified graphic pipeline for several types of geometry like scan data and CAD entities.

Development of Software renderer engine -
Using only CPU power for thin client situation, I developed in-house graphic library similar with OpenGL. The characteristic of this engine is a single pipe line for overlap transparent meshes and well-implemented light map.



Registered(or applied) Patents
* Method for detecting 3D scanning data using allowable error zone - 7830376(US), 10-660415(KR), 2006-320213(JPN), 102006058017.6-53(GER)
* System and Method for recalculating analysis report of 3D scan data - 7365863(US), 10-602594(KR), 2005-343639(JPN), 102005058699.6-52(GER)
* System and Method for Automatic 3D Scan Data Alignment - 7639253(US), 10-898138(KR), 2007-183304(JPN), 102007032061.4(GER)
* System and method for calculating loft surfaces using 3D scan data - 10-0914218(KOR), 11/759641(US), 2007-254248(JPN), 102007043923.9(GER)

Journal Article - A grouping algorithm for custom-tailored products [http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0924013602007641]
